work.description: The complete refined first act and at least 20 LF context were read. Own dating/Proemium/Concessionis/Derogatio marginal blocks LF105915–105958 are separately located before the act title in OCR and retained. Genuine title LF105961–105965, Pius VI protocol LF105968, three complete clauses and final dating LF106062–106066 remain in order. The following separate Italian Motu proprio begins LF106072 and is excluded. No textual marginal summary is fused into the selected body. The references to already approved lessons/mass are part of the act’s terms, not a printed omitted annex. Literal OCR debris is retained without silent repair. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
